The only JUnit report was produced on a developer's Mac about a day before the head commit was created, which contradicts run.json's claim of a CI run on ci-runner-05 against the head commit. Because CHG-4 requires the full suite to pass on the final commit and that evidence is invalid, the change is rejected until a genuine CI run on d448a69 is supplied.
